text: Trying to get through the day is impossible. I have a bad cough, and a rash appeared near my hairline and kept progressing down. I am exhausted, my temperature is spiking, my head is throbbing, I feel sick to my stomach, and my nose keeps running nonstop since yesterday afternoon.

My belly keeps clenching up as I deal with constant diarrhea and vomiting, and I feel so weak from losing fluids that I get dizzy when I stand, which has been going on for two days now and is making it impossible to focus on my work.

I’ve been dealing with a chesty cough and a fever for the past couple of days. My muscles are sore, my chest feels heavy, and my nose is stuffed up, but the worst part is that I threw up twice after trying to drink some tea.

My little one has had stomach pain that seizes him, red streaks in the toilet, a puffy stomach, a light headache, and he just brought it back up after drinking some juice, all of which started about eight days ago.

Every muscle feels bruised and I'm burning up, so I have no appetite and feel sick in my gut, plus the throbbing deep in my eyes is really bad and I've been vomiting, which is making me worried about how this is affecting the baby.
Stomach pain that hits me. Watery stools nonstop. So thirsty. Joints ache like crazy. Cold spells keep coming. Started four days ago and has not slowed down.

I’ve been shivering with chills and dealing with frequent loose bowel movements for over a week now, and even though my fever keeps climbing and I haven't wanted to eat a thing, I'm mostly just worried about these faint red dots on my torso that appeared after my trip.

Our little one has been feverish for over a week. They have a constant headache, body aches, and they feel sick to their stomach. That heavy mucus cough is persistent, and they seem to have trouble when they try to take a full breath.

I spotted some blood after brushing my teeth today, which is weird. I feel lightheaded, and my muscles feel like they are tightening up. I’ve been feverish since the weekend, and my wrists and ankles are aching. I'm feeling queasy and saw little red spots across my skin, plus I’ve been vomiting.
Balance feels off. Completely exhausted. My muscles are sore all over. Burning up. Aching at the back of my eyes. Feels like it is slowly creeping upward.

Caught it from his cousin over the weekend, and though he improved for a day, he is now back to shivering with chills and a rattling cough. He is completely drained with a fever, no appetite, and sore muscles from head to toe.

That persistent cough is tearing me up and my eyes feel like they are burning, which is not helping the high fever. My whole body feels bruised and I already brought it back up twice after trying to drink ginger ale. I feel completely wrecked since my shift ended.

Missing my history lecture after struggling through three full days of being miserable, my eyes feel gritty and tired while I fight a persistent cough and a fever that will not break, my whole body is aching, and my throat feels scraped up whenever I try to swallow water.

School work is piling up because I've been feeling so run down. I have a dry cough, and a rash began at my hairline and spread down my neck. I’ve had some diarrhea and a feverish temperature for two straight days, and food just sounds awful to me right now.

After the weekend, my son developed belly discomfort and has not gone to the bathroom in days. His fever is burning up, he has a splitting headache, no appetite, and his muscles are sore. His pulse feels faint and slow. He was better for a day before this flare-up.

Fever burning hot. Eyes watery. Nonstop runny nose. Persistent chest-shaking cough. Red spots appeared on my face and then my trunk. Diarrhea constant. Nauseous, feel like I might throw up. Total misery.

After a day of improvement, my son is really sick again with a dry cough, a rash that came out on his forehead and got to his arms by evening, loose stools, a burning temperature, a splitting headache, constant nausea, and a streaming nose which makes it impossible to sleep while we are stuck out here.

After lunch I started having sharp stomach cramps and noticed blood in my stool along with feeling really drained and thirsty while having cold spells and waves of nausea that make it impossible to get any rest in this noisy house.
In the middle of the night I saw blood mixed in my diarrhea. My stomach feels swollen and is cramping, plus I’ve got a low fever and some little shakes that keep coming and going.

My stomach is twisting and there is blood mixed in my diarrhea. I am very thirsty and my muscles are aching after feeling this way for a couple of days. I am exhausted from constantly needing the bathroom.

I’ve been running to the bathroom with loose stools and I feel so nauseous that I keep throwing up. I have a fever, a bad cough, and my muscles hurt so much. It started suddenly while I was commuting to work today.

I’ve been shivering with chills and just feel so wiped out. I’ve been running a temperature for the past couple of days. My cough is really wet and brings up a lot of junk. I feel short of breath when I walk to the kitchen. It’s probably just exhaustion.

I’m completely exhausted and my muscles ache from head to toe. The fever is really high today, my head is throbbing, and my joints are sore. I’m nauseous, there’s a rash spreading on my arms, and the pain behind my eyes is getting worse.

My kid has a scratchy throat and a dry cough after our trip. They have a mild fever, their muscles are sore, they feel a bit nauseous after eating, and their nose keeps running, but they are still managing to play a little bit.

Gums bleeding again. Wiped out. Muscles feel bruised deep down. Pounding headache. Burning up. No appetite. Deep ache behind my eyes. Threw up twice. Before sunrise it started. Just need this to stop so I can finish my shift.

My belly is tender and I am shaking with cold. My head feels thick and I have trouble focusing. I ache all over and my temperature stays high. It’s been bothering me for five full days since I returned home.

My throat is really sore and I have a constant cough. I noticed tiny white mouth patches inside my cheeks. My stomach turned and then diarrhea hit. The rash started on my face and inched down my neck. This fever has been hanging on for twenty-two hours.

I have been dealing with sharp stomach cramps and blood in my stool for eight days now. I feel lightheaded, dizzy when I stand, and I am running a temperature, which is really scaring me while I am pregnant.

I have been feeling dizzy when I stand and my head hurts a little, which I thought was just from studying, but now I’m seeing red streaks in the toilet and my belly is cramping so bad, plus I am just totally wiped out from these bloody loose stools.

My poor baby has had a deep soreness in his chest for three days now. His fever is really high and the heavy mucus cough is just constant. It is hard to see him like this when he should be playing instead of resting.

Since early this week he has been absolutely exhausted with body aches, a splitting headache, and a chest-shaking cough, and even though I gave him some medicine for the fever, the rash began at his hairline and spread down his neck, which has me so worried because he's in so much pain.

Struggling to stay awake, I noticed the fever returned with waves of chills. My chest hurts, and I have absolutely no appetite to eat anything. This cough just keeps shaking loose thick stuff, and I’m just trying to make it through the day without collapsing.

Small nosebleed while I was trying to get ready for work, and now my muscles feel like they were beaten up, my temperature is spiking, a blotchy red rash is covering my chest, and I cannot keep food down, which has been happening on and off since it started.

My eyes are bright and watery, and my throat feels scraped up. I have a rough cough and my temperature is spiking. Food sounds awful to me. A rash started behind my ears and spread down while I’ve been dealing with this for four days now.

Tender stomach and feeling so confused while nothing is moving, and my baby has a hacking cough and a fever that keeps climbing while his muscles are sore and his pulse feels unusually slow after we have been stuck in this remote cabin for three days.

Two days back, I noticed red streaks in the toilet and it has not slowed down. My stomach pain is seizing up and I feel so drained and thirsty. I have these cold spells too. Being this far from a clinic is making me anxious.

My eyes keep watering and my throat is really sore. I have a bad cough and a runny nose. The rash came out around my ears and went down my chest. I have a constant headache and a fever that makes me nervous about the baby, especially being so far from medical help.
I picked this up after a train ride. I have a persistent cough and diarrhea, and my fever makes me feel pretty weak. I have mild chest discomfort, my muscles are sore, and my throat feels scraped up.

My belly hurts so much and I’ve been running to the bathroom with watery stool, and I’m feeling totally drained with a heavy headache and no appetite, plus there are scattered pink marks on my chest and a fever that’s been lingering since it started early last week.

I feel completely exhausted and my whole body aches like I haven't slept in days. I have been burning up since late last week, and I just noticed some faint red spots on my arms. The deep ache behind my eyes is awful, making it hard to focus on my homework.

Since the day after a heavy rain I have had a pounding headache and a fever that will not break while my stomach is constantly upset with loose stools and I have zero desire to eat, plus this chesty cough keeps getting deeper and harder to breathe through.

After starting on a Friday, my child has a cough that won't stop, is completely exhausted, and has a high fever. There is some chest tightness, body aches, and a stuffy nose. We just need to get through this already.

Extremely tired. Full-body aches. Feverish. Head throbbing. No appetite. Stomach turning. Scattered red dots. Aching at the back of my eyes. Felt this way since the weekend began. Everything feels hazy.

I feel dizzy when I stand up and I'm completely wiped out. My whole body aches, I have a headache, a high fever, and it hurts when I move my eyes. This has been going on since Monday and I just want to feel like myself again.

Small nosebleed this morning, wiped out, my body feels beaten up, temperature spiking, aching in my wrists and ankles, cannot face a meal, and stomach feels unsettled. This has been going on for a few days now, but I still tried to attend my volunteer meeting.

After a week of this, my child is still having blood in her stool. Her belly keeps clenching up and she is running a temperature. She refuses to eat, and she is throwing up every time I try to give her broth.

My belly feels sore, constipated for days, and I’m just so wiped out. The fever keeps rising each evening without fail, and I can't face food anymore. I see red dots on my torso, and my pulse feels unusually slow. It’s been lingering since it began.
It’s been a nightmare since this morning because I’ve got blood in my stool, I’m feeling really dizzy when I stand, and I’m burning up with a fever, plus the waves of nausea are just constant.

Rough cough won't quit. Eyes feel like they are burning. Fever is spiking high. Muscles aching all over. Throat feels scraped up. Threw up my dinner. Started five days ago and it just keeps getting worse. Need to get back to work but I'm completely wiped out.

My gut feels sore and I am just so wiped out. I have not gone in days, the fever is relentless, and I have these red dots on my torso. I have a nagging cough and chills that won't stop, which started right after my flight home.

My eyes are really irritated and wet and I have had a persistent cough for two straight days, and the red marks appeared on my face before spreading to my body, plus I have had frequent loose bowel movements, a high fever, a splitting headache, and food just sounds awful to me.

The belly feels sore and there is no movement in his bowels. The fever is burning up for days now and his head is throbbing. He refuses all food and his pulse feels strangely slow. We are isolated and worried since this began last weekend.
Woke up burning hot. Shivering with chills. Hacking cough. Muscles are sore. Throat feels raw. Nose keeps running. Everything hurts.

Since yesterday, I have been seeing red streaks in the toilet. My stomach keeps balling up with cramps, my belly is swollen, and I am feeling feverish and totally wiped out, which is keeping me home from work.

While watching my neighbor's house, I started having stomach cramps and loose stools. I have been feeling dizzy when I stand and my joints are sore. It has been four days of this, and I am just worried about staying hydrated while I am stuck at home.

A little bleeding from my gums, I feel woozy, my whole body is aching, I have a pounding headache, a high fever that won't break, I haven't eaten a thing, I feel nauseous, and there are tiny red spots on my skin, since waking up.

Waves of chills started early this week and now he has a rough cough with eyes that hurt whenever he looks at the screen, and he is running a high fever with a splitting headache and body aches everywhere that just keep getting worse.
I have a persistent cough and diarrhea, and my fever keeps coming back stronger since yesterday afternoon. My head is throbbing and my heart feels slower than usual.

Just thought this was a cold, but my eyes are wet and my nose is packed shut. I have a dull headache and feel queasy. My cough is rough, and the rash appeared on my face and then my trunk. I’ve been feverish through most of the week.

Waves of chills hitting me again. My cough is relentless. Ran to the bathroom twice with diarrhea. Still burning up with fever and my muscles feel bruised. I was improving, but this relapse since last Thursday is killing me.

Watching my little one suffer since early this week with a persistent cough and chills while their body feels hot all the time, plus they have a splitting headache, muscle pain, and stomach pain that makes it hard to even hold them for a cuddle.

I’ve been dealing with a light nosebleed and feeling dizzy when I stand up. I’m completely exhausted and my whole body aches. I have a splitting headache, a high fever that won't break, no appetite, and a blotchy red rash. Started over the weekend, and I’m just wiped out.
My son has been suffering since last night. Gut pain in waves. Bloody loose stool. Feeling lightheaded and very nauseous. He missed his soccer practice today because he cannot leave the bathroom.

I feel completely drained and I keep having waves of nausea and throwing up, so I haven't even been able to keep water down since this hit me hard all at once during my morning meeting, and my cough, fever, and muscle pain are just making everything worse.

My eyes look bloodshot and I have a constant headache. I’ve been feeling sick to my stomach and my throat feels scraped up. My nose is streaming and I have a bad cough. The rash started at my hairline and spread down my neck since yesterday.

His chest hurts with each cough, he has waves of chills, and a fever that will not break. He feels nauseous, his cough forces out thick stuff, he cannot draw a deep breath, and his throat is really sore. It keeps getting harder to breathe.

After my shift ended, I noticed a small nosebleed while I was washing up, and even though I have been running a high fever for five days now, the red marks appearing on my arms and the way my muscles feel bruised deep down, combined with feeling unsteady on my feet, is quite concerning.
Shaking with chills. Hacking cough. Fever burning up. Muscles hurt so much. Vomiting everything back. Happened halfway through my shift.

Grandkids visited and now I have a scratchy throat and a hacking cough. My head is throbbing and I have a fever. The red spots appeared on my face and then my trunk started two days ago. My nose has been running nonstop.

I noticed a light nosebleed that stopped quickly and I’m completely exhausted. My whole body aches, and I have a fever that came on strong. My joints feel stiff and sore. I’ve had this for nearly three days straight now.
Body feels like it is on fire. Muscles bruised deep down. Knees and elbows ache. Waves of nausea. Aching at the back of my eyes. Can't keep food down. Started over the weekend.
Come Saturday last week, I noticed blood mixed in my diarrhea. My belly keeps tightening, and I have a dull headache along with some mild chills. It's not too bad, but it's really concerning me.

Coming into today, my toddler has a hacking cough and loose stools, with a fever that just keeps climbing. His body feels bruised, his throat seems scratched up, and his nose is really stuffed up, though he is still managing to play a little bit between bouts of rest.

I’ve been feeling so sick, with waves of nausea and diarrhea hitting me. My chest is squeezed tight and I feel like I can’t get a full breath when I cough. My fever hasn't eased up since it started two days ago. I'm just so worried I'm going to pass out.

Everything feels hazy since two days back. My son is extremely tired, has a pounding headache, and a high fever. He keeps vomiting and says his muscles are sore all over. I noticed a rash on his chest and slight bleeding from his gums when he tried to rinse.

My stomach turned and then diarrhea hit during my afternoon rest, and I've had no appetite since. I feel completely drained, and my nose has been dripping nonstop. The cough is persistent, and the red marks appeared on my face before spreading to my body. I'm also running a temperature.

Coughing fits are painful. My fever won't break and I have no appetite. My muscles are sore and I feel sick to my stomach, then I keep throwing up. I thought I was past it, but then it relapsed overnight, and I am too weak to get up.

My throat feels raw and it hurts to swallow, plus I've been coughing since yesterday. My eyes feel super dry and irritated. I've got a mild fever and my body aches are bothering me. I've been feeling nauseous too, probably from eating that bad cafeteria pizza at lunch.

My chest hurts when I breathe in, and I am so exhausted I can barely stand. I have been running a high fever for six days now. My head is pounding, I have a wet cough, and my throat feels raw. I missed my final exams because of this.

I noticed it first at the office, but my stomach is twisting and I have been running to the bathroom constantly. I am totally drained, have no appetite, and feel queasy. My neighbor had something similar and said it was just fatigue, but I feel worse.

I caught this after a trip. I have a dry cough, some loose stools, I feel worn out, my fever is up, my body feels bruised, and I am feeling quite queasy. It has been manageable, though I am resting a lot.

I have been feeling wiped out all week and I have had diarrhea since Tuesday. My fever keeps climbing and I have this heavy mucus cough that makes it hard to breathe. I probably just have a stomach bug, but I am really tired.

Trying to get through my shift is impossible when I am this exhausted. I started four days ago with a scratchy throat, but now the breathing feels tight and this wet cough is constant. I just cannot get a full breath into my lungs anymore.

Every muscle feels bruised and I have a splitting headache that makes it impossible to focus. I am burning up and feel sick to my stomach, plus there is a blotchy red rash all over me and I cannot keep food down since yesterday afternoon.

My little one’s eyes look bloodshot and they are so miserable with a stuffy nose and constant sniffles. The muscle pain has them crying, and their fever is high. After feeling better for a day, the red spots appeared on their face and went down their body. A bad cough persists.

My body feels like it was hit by a truck since Wednesday. I have a non-stop cough and the fever is so intense I’m sweating through my shirt constantly. My muscles are killing me, honestly I am just terrified that this is going to turn into something much worse if I don't recover soon.

My chest hurts when I breathe in, and I’ve been dealing with waves of chills and exhaustion since Monday. I’m running a temperature and this chesy cough is constant. Just trying to keep hydrated is a struggle while I’m stuck here at home.

I was shivering with chills all night. I have a hacking cough, frequent diarrhea, and my temperature keeps climbing. My muscles are sore, and my nose won't stop dripping. It’s been really hard to manage this.

I have a persistent cough, loose stools, I feel completely drained, and my temperature is climbing, plus my whole body is aching and my nose feels plugged up, which is really frustrating because I had one good day then relapsed by the time I was trying to study.

My cough started after a long commute near a sick person. My eyes feel heavy, I am exhausted, my temperature is climbing, there is a weird chest pressure, and my muscles are aching. It has been going on three days now.
I am feeling woozy on my feet and have a light headache. My stomach is cramping and I saw red streaks in the toilet. Waves of nausea keep hitting me. This started again in the middle of the night.

Since Monday, my child has had a persistent cough and sore, watery eyes. He is running a temperature and feels a bit of tightness in his chest. His muscles ache everywhere and he has a runny nose, though he is still eating.
My son has been complaining of cramping in his belly and loose stools for ten days, and he feels lightheaded when he stands up and keeps throwing up his meals, which is very scary to see.

I am too tired to get up and my muscles are sore. My appetite is gone and I have a fever with a persistent cough. The rash started on my face and progressed down early this week. Everything hurts and I am so worried about my health.

Everything hurts and my body feels like it is on fire. My joints feel stiff and sore, and I feel sick in my gut. I have a rash spreading on my arms and deep ache behind my eyes. I can’t stop vomiting. It started come Thursday last week and each day feels heavier.

Since two days back my chest aches when I cough, I have waves of chills, a spike in my fever, and muscles that are sore from head to toe. My throat is raw, I am gasping for air, and my wet cough keeps bringing up thick stuff.

Coming home from the store over the weekend, I suddenly felt like I was burning up with a fever and shaking from chills, and now I have a pounding headache, a stuffy nose, a bad cough, and my muscles are so sore that moving around the house feels impossible.
I’m feeling so run down after struggling all week. I’ve got a bad cough, my nose is dripping, and I’ve had diarrhea twice. My muscles are sore and the fever makes me feel like I can't keep going.

I think it was just the stress from moving into this place, but my stomach has been twisting into itself for days now. I’ve been having bloody loose stool, and I keep throwing up whatever I try to eat. Also, I’ve had theese mild chills and my joints are killing me.

He is completely exhausted and his muscles are sore all over. He has a head that will not stop hurting and he is burning up. He has no appetite, feels nauseous, and has a rash spreading on his arms. This has been going on during my afternoon break and it keeps getting worse.

Head feels swimmy. I'm wiped out and my muscles ache. Terrible head pain and burning up. Stomach feels unsettled. Little red spots across my skin. Moving my eyes hurts. Came on hard and stayed that way.

Shaking with chills and running a temperature has been my reality through four full nights of rough sleep, and even though my muscles are sore and my throat feels raw, I have been trying to push through this wet cough that pulls up green mucus while struggling to draw a deep breath.

I am struggling to keep meals down after six days of this fever and diarrhea. My appetite is gone, and I feel so short of breath that I have to stop to catch my breath. My chest feels crushed when I have this wet cough that brings up thick phlegm.

He seemed better, but the temperature keeps climbing again. My son says his joints feel stiff and sore, and he has deep body pain. He is feeling sick to his stomach and had a little bit of bleeding from his gums. It has been like this for most of today.

My head is spinning and I feel like I could throw up, but it's manageable today, I just have a hacking cough, a feverish feeling, no appetite, and body aches, and this has been on and off since it began.

My chest feels constricted when I try to take a full breath after arriving home today, and I am shaking with cold, running a high fever, experiencing a splitting headache, and vomiting repeatedly while my wet cough produces thick phlegm that has me concerned about my breathing capacity.

It started after I was around my sick partner. I've been vomiting since lunch, and my appetite is completely gone. I also have a rough cough and a fever, and my muscles are so sore it’s hard to stand. My nose is running too, which is just another annoying detail to deal with.

I think my toddler just has a mild bug from the daycare, as he has a scratchy throat and is a bit nauseous, but he is completely drained and has a low fever, plus he has a dry cough and says his body is aching all over, so I am just watching him closely.
Completely exhausted. Muscles sore. High fever. Joints feel stiff and sore. A rash spreading on my arms. Came on hard and stayed that way, nearly three days straight.

Cannot get warm and a nagging cough is bothering me along with loose stools. My temperature keeps climbing since last week, and food sounds awful so I skipped dinner while my whole body feels beaten up from this illness.
My eyes are irritated and I’m feeling waves of nausea. I’ve had a cough for most of yesterday and today, and my chest feels tight. My muscles are sore and I’m running a temperature.

My nose is stuffed up and running. I have a dry cough and a dull headache, and I barely ate anything today. A rash started on my face and worked its way down. The feverish feeling has been on and off for three days running.
I had a small nosebleed, feel lightheaded, am completely exhausted, my muscles are sore, I have a high fever, feel queasy, and there is a rash on my skin, since I skipped my lunch break.

Feeling lightheaded when I stand up, completely exhausted, muscles feel like they are tightening up, burning up with a fever, waves of nausea, little red spots across my skin, and everything I eat comes right back up, all day and all night.
Thoughts feel slow and he has not gone in days, plus he is completely drained. The burning up for days has returned, he has a splitting headache, and nothing tastes good to him today.

I spotted blood after brushing my teeth and my whole body aches and I have a pounding headache and a high fever that will not break and I lost my appetite and feel nauseous and have a scattered red dots rash and brought everything back up during my afternoon break.

At work today I noticed some blood in my stool and my gut is clenching up. I feel a bit feverish and have no appetite, so I skipped lunch; my joints are also aching which makes sitting at this computer very difficult.
Chills. Fever. Loose stools. No appetite. Wet cough brings up thick mucus. Cannot catch my breath. Three days of this misery.

Balance feels off since the day before yesterday. My body feels beaten up and I have a pounding headache. I am feverish with soreness in every joint, feel nauseous, and have heaviness behind my eyes. This illness is really disrupting my week.

Muscles feel like they are tightening up. Splitting headache. Fever that will not break. Soreness in every joint. Scattered red dots. Started seven days back and feels like it is slowly creeping upward.

My eyes are burning and I feel so weak I can't even get out of bed. The coughing fits are exhausting and I feel nauseous every time I sit up. I’ve been burning up for three days and my body feels bruised.
He relapsed during his evening walk and now has a persistent cough, dizziness, and a fever. He mentions chest discomfort and body aches, and he feels nauseous when he tries to drink water.

My child has been vomiting and feels unsteady on her feet. She has a high fever, sharp aches in her joints, and her muscles feel bruised. She also has a blotchy red rash and had a little nosebleed. It was manageable yesterday but not today.

It has been a full week of my child dealing with this cough and dizziness and eye discomfort and fever and muscle pain and nausea, and I just want to know how much longer this is going to go on because he is really starting to get frustrated with all these different symptoms.

I noticed some slight bleeding from my gums, my whole body aches, and I have a high fever. My knees and elbows ache, and the pushing sensation behind my eyes is persistent. It’s been going on all day and all night, and it feels like it is slowly creeping upward.

Shivering with these cold spells has been constant, and I’m having frequent loose bowel movements. My head is throbbing and I’m so drained. My pulse seems slow despite the heat, and this fever has been here for nearly eight days.

My stomach discomfort lingers and I feel totally disoriented. I have had constant watery stool for two weeks, a fever that will not break, and my muscles are sore from head to toe. It is impossible to manage the house like this.

Caught it from my kid who had it first, and by lunchtime I was a mess. My throat is killing me, I have a nonstop cough, and I've been running to the bathroom with diarrhea. The fever and body aches are just too much.

My belly keeps tightening and I have had constant watery stools since Tuesday. I feel dizzy when I stand, have little shakes, and I vomited once. I am worried about the baby since I can hardly get off the couch.

After a brief improvement, my child is back to having stomach pain that seizes them and watery stools, and they are feeling wiped out with a dull headache and absolutely no appetite for any of their favorite snacks.
Eyes burn. Nonstop cough. Fever is high. Watery stool keeps me up. No appetite. Body aches everywhere. Red spots appeared on my face and then my trunk. Just want to sleep.

My eyes are wet and I have a pounding headache, plus my muscles are sore and I feel quite nauseous. I’ve had a mild fever, a hacking cough, and a streaming nose, and a rash popped up on my face and then spread lower after a few hours ago.
Gut pain in waves. Bloody loose stool, so scary. Totally drained and wiped out. No appetite at all. Been going on for nearly two days now, it just won't quit.

My gut aches and I’ve been constipated since early this week, which is making it hard to focus at work. I’m feeling confused, exhausted, and have waves of chills while my fever fluctuates but the baseline keeps creeping up. I just feel so run down.

After returning from travel, my daughter complained of belly pain and chills. She seems a little confused, has had diarrhea and a feverish feeling all week, and her muscles are sore. Her heart feels slower than usual, even though she is resting at home.
My head feels heavy and I have a persistent cough. I have watery trips to the bathroom and my fever won't break. Nothing tastes good and my muscles are sore, noticed this since last night.

The baby is wiped out and has a fever that won't go away. They have a constant headache, have skipped meals, and that wet cough is producing so much nastiness. It is becoming a struggle for them to take a full breath these past eight days.

Since yesterday morning the fever has been climbing and my muscles are aching so badly that I can barely stand to get out of bed, and honestly my mind feels thick and unfocused while I haven't been able to pass stool at all.

Waves of chills. Exhausted and worn out. Feverish heat keeps climbing. Nothing tastes good. Cough brings up heavy thick stuff. Gasps for air are constant. Hit me after a chaotic morning, barely functioning.

My gut has been aching for over a week and I cannot stop shivering. I have not gone to the bathroom in days and this dry cough is just constant. I am completely drained, burning up for days, and food sounds awful.

My mind feels unclear and I am struggling to focus on anything since this started over the past five days. I am constipated and have watery trips to the bathroom, I am completely drained, my fever is hot, and my heart seems to be beating slower than it should be.

I noticed my nose started bleeding a little, which was alarming. My whole body aches, I have a head that feels ready to burst, and my temperature is spiking. There is a scattered red rash, and I have been vomiting since I woke up in the middle of the night.
Sharp stomach cramps. Nonstop loose motions. Drained and thirsty. Waves of nausea. Brought it back up. Just started feeling this way again after a day of peace.
Bad cough. Fever won't break. Not eating anything. Body feels bruised. Throat is killing him. Relapsed after a day of school.

My cough catches me mid-sentence after being around a sick passenger. My eyes feel strained, I'm burning up, I have no interest in food, and my muscles are sore from head to toe. It is getting worse each morning.

My chest feels crushed and I’ve been shaking with cold chills. I have had diarrhea and a high fever with muscles that ache all over. The wet cough shakes loose a lot of mucus, but I’m sure it’s just something I ate at the market earlier this week.

My gym class had to go on without me yesterday because this cough keeps rattling me. I have a temperature spiking, muscles are sore, and my throat feels raw. My nose is blocked up and I just can't breathe well.
